name: Veg Manchow Soup
ingredients: 1 cup finely chopped mixed vegetables (cabbage, carrot, beans, capsicum)
2 tbsp cornflour mixed in ¼ cup water
preparation: Heat oil in a deep pan, sauté garlic and ginger for 30 seconds.
Add the chopped vegetables and stir-fry on high flame for 2 minutes.
Pour in the vegetable stock, soy sauce, chilli sauce, pepper and salt; bring to a boil.
Stir in the cornflour slurry and simmer 3–4 minutes until the soup thickens.
Add vinegar and spring onion, switch off.
Serve hot topped with crisp fried noodles.

name: Sweet Corn Veg Soup
ingredients: ½ cup finely chopped carrot and beans
2 tbsp cornflour mixed in ¼ cup water
preparation: Boil the stock with corn kernels and cream-style corn for 5 minutes.
Add carrot, beans and cabbage; cook 4–5 minutes until just tender.
Season with salt, sugar and white pepper.
Add the cornflour slurry and simmer until glossy and slightly thick.
Finish with vinegar and serve hot.

name: Hot and Sour Soup
ingredients: 1 cup julienned vegetables (carrot, cabbage, capsicum, mushroom)
2 tbsp cornflour mixed in ¼ cup water
preparation: Heat oil, sauté garlic and ginger briefly.
Add julienned vegetables and stir-fry 2 minutes on high.
Add stock, soy sauce, chilli sauce, pepper and salt; simmer 5 minutes.
Add tofu and the cornflour slurry; cook until thickened.
Add vinegar, check seasoning, top with spring onion greens.

name: Lemon Coriander Soup
ingredients: ½ cup chopped fresh coriander (stems and leaves)
1 tbsp cornflour mixed in ¼ cup water
preparation: Heat oil and sauté ginger and coriander stems for a minute.
Add stock, cabbage, carrot and corn; simmer 6–7 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper, add cornflour slurry and cook 2 minutes.
Switch off, stir in lemon juice and coriander leaves, serve hot.

name: Veg Manchurian (Dry)
preparation: Squeeze excess water from grated cabbage and carrot; mix with capsicum, cornflour, maida, ginger-garlic paste, pepper and salt into a dough-like mixture.
Shape into small balls and deep-fry on medium heat until golden and crisp; drain.
Heat 1 tbsp oil, sauté garlic, ginger and green chillies for 30 seconds.
Add soy sauce, chilli sauce, ketchup and vinegar; toss for a minute.
Add fried balls, toss on high flame until coated, finish with spring onion.

name: Chilli Paneer (Dry)
preparation: Toss paneer cubes in cornflour, maida, pepper and salt; shallow-fry in 2 tbsp oil until golden, set aside.
Heat 1 tbsp oil, sauté garlic, ginger and green chillies for 30 seconds.
Add onion and capsicum; stir-fry on high flame 2 minutes keeping them crunchy.
Add soy sauce, chilli sauce and vinegar; toss.
Add fried paneer, toss to coat, finish with spring onion.

name: Vegetable Spring Rolls
ingredients: 2 tbsp maida mixed with 2 tbsp water (for sealing)
preparation: Heat 2 tbsp oil, sauté garlic, add cabbage, carrot, capsicum and stir-fry 3 minutes on high.
Add noodles, soy sauce, pepper and salt; mix and cool completely.
Place filling on a wrapper, fold sides, roll tightly and seal the edge with the flour paste.
Deep-fry on medium heat until golden and crisp.
Serve hot with schezwan chutney.

name: Crispy Chilli Corn
preparation: Pat the corn dry, toss with cornflour, rice flour, pepper and salt.
Deep-fry in small batches on medium-high heat until crisp (stand back — corn pops); drain.
Heat 1 tbsp oil, sauté garlic, green chilli, onion and capsicum for 2 minutes.
Add soy sauce and chilli flakes, then the crispy corn; toss quickly.
Finish with spring onion and serve immediately.

name: Honey Chilli Potato
preparation: Soak potato fingers in water 10 minutes, drain and pat dry; toss with cornflour, rice flour and salt.
Deep-fry until golden and crisp; drain.
Heat 1 tbsp oil, sauté garlic and ginger; add chilli sauce, soy sauce, honey and vinegar; cook 1 minute.
Add fried potatoes and toss on high flame to coat.
Sprinkle sesame seeds and spring onion, serve immediately.

name: Paneer 65
preparation: Mix cornflour, maida, ginger-garlic paste, chilli powder, turmeric, garam masala, curd and salt into a thick batter.
Coat paneer cubes and rest 10 minutes.
Deep-fry on medium heat until golden and crisp; drain.
In the same oil, flash-fry curry leaves and green chillies for 10 seconds, toss with paneer.
Squeeze lemon juice and serve hot.

name: Veg Manchurian Gravy
ingredients: 2 tbsp cornflour mixed in ¼ cup water (for gravy)
preparation: Mix cabbage, carrot, cornflour, maida, ginger-garlic paste and salt; shape into balls and deep-fry until golden. Set aside.
Heat 1 tbsp oil, sauté garlic, ginger, green chilli and onion for 2 minutes.
Add soy sauce, chilli sauce and ketchup; stir 30 seconds.
Pour in stock, bring to a boil, add cornflour slurry and simmer until thick and glossy.
Add vinegar and the fried balls just before serving so they stay firm; garnish with spring onion.

name: Chilli Paneer Gravy
ingredients: 1 tbsp cornflour mixed in ¼ cup water
preparation: Coat paneer in cornflour and salt; shallow-fry in 2 tbsp oil until golden, set aside.
Heat 1 tbsp oil, sauté garlic, ginger and green chillies; add onion and capsicum, stir-fry 2 minutes.
Add soy sauce, chilli sauce, ketchup and pepper.
Add stock, bring to a boil, thicken with cornflour slurry.
Add paneer and vinegar, simmer 2 minutes, garnish with spring onion.

name: Szechuan Tofu with Vegetables
ingredients: 1 tbsp cornflour mixed in ¼ cup water
preparation: Toss tofu in 2 tbsp cornflour and shallow-fry in 2 tbsp oil until golden; set aside.
Heat 1 tbsp oil, sauté garlic and ginger; add onion, capsicum, broccoli and mushrooms, stir-fry 3 minutes.
Add schezwan sauce, soy sauce, sugar and vinegar.
Pour in stock, boil, thicken with slurry.
Add tofu, toss gently, simmer 1 minute and serve.

name: Sweet and Sour Vegetables
ingredients: 1 cup pineapple chunks (fresh or tinned, drained)
1½ tbsp cornflour mixed in ¼ cup water
preparation: Heat oil, sauté garlic; add onion, carrot, baby corn and capsicum, stir-fry 3 minutes.
Add pineapple and paneer or tofu.
Mix ketchup, vinegar, sugar and soy sauce with the stock and pour in; bring to a boil.
Add cornflour slurry and simmer until glossy.
Season with salt and serve hot with fried rice.

name: Kung Pao Paneer
ingredients: 1 tsp cornflour mixed in 2 tbsp water
preparation: Coat paneer in cornflour, shallow-fry in 2 tbsp oil until golden; set aside.
Heat 1 tbsp oil, fry the dry red chillies 20 seconds, then add garlic and ginger.
Add onion and capsicum; stir-fry 2 minutes.
Add soy sauce, vinegar, chilli sauce, sugar and stock; thicken with slurry.
Add paneer and peanuts, toss to coat, garnish with spring onion.

name: Vegetables in Hot Garlic Sauce
ingredients: 3 cups mixed vegetables (broccoli, cauliflower, carrot, beans, baby corn, capsicum)
1½ tbsp cornflour mixed in ¼ cup water
preparation: Blanch the hard vegetables (broccoli, cauliflower, carrot, beans) in salted boiling water 2 minutes; drain.
Heat oil, fry garlic until light golden, add ginger and chilli flakes.
Add all vegetables and stir-fry 2 minutes on high.
Add chilli sauce, soy sauce, ketchup and stock; boil and thicken with slurry.
Finish with vinegar and serve with noodles or rice.

name: Mushroom in Black Bean Sauce
ingredients: 1 tbsp cornflour mixed in ¼ cup water
preparation: Heat oil, sauté garlic and ginger; add onion and capsicum, stir-fry 2 minutes.
Add mushrooms and cook on high 3 minutes until they release and re-absorb moisture.
Add black bean paste, soy sauce and sugar; stir 1 minute.
Add stock, boil, thicken with slurry.
Garnish with spring onion; check salt (black bean paste is salty).

name: Chilli Mushroom Gravy
ingredients: 1 tbsp cornflour mixed in ¼ cup water
preparation: Toss mushrooms in cornflour and shallow-fry in 2 tbsp oil until browned; set aside.
Heat 1 tbsp oil, sauté garlic and green chillies; add onion and capsicum, stir-fry 2 minutes.
Add soy sauce, chilli sauce and ketchup.
Add stock, boil, thicken with slurry.
Return mushrooms, add vinegar, garnish with spring onion.

name: Veg Fried Rice
ingredients: 1 cup finely chopped mixed vegetables (carrot, beans, capsicum, cabbage)
½ cup finely chopped spring onion (white and green separated)
preparation: Heat oil in a wok until smoking; sauté garlic and spring onion whites 30 seconds.
Add vegetables and stir-fry 2–3 minutes on the highest flame.
Add rice, soy sauce, vinegar, pepper and salt; toss without breaking the grains.
Cook 2 minutes more, finish with spring onion greens.

name: Schezwan Fried Rice
ingredients: 1 cup finely chopped mixed vegetables (carrot, beans, capsicum, cabbage)
preparation: Heat oil in a wok, sauté garlic and spring onion whites.
Add vegetables and stir-fry 2 minutes on high.
Add schezwan sauce and soy sauce, stir 30 seconds.
Add rice, salt and vinegar; toss on high flame 2 minutes.
Finish with spring onion greens.

name: Veg Hakka Noodles
ingredients: 1 cup julienned vegetables (carrot, cabbage, capsicum, beans)
preparation: Boil noodles until just done, drain, rinse in cold water and toss with 1 tsp oil.
Heat oil in a wok, sauté garlic and spring onion whites.
Add vegetables and stir-fry 2 minutes on high.
Add soy sauce, chilli sauce, vinegar, pepper and salt.
Add noodles, toss with tongs 2 minutes, finish with spring onion greens.

name: Schezwan Noodles
preparation: Boil noodles until al dente, drain and rinse.
Heat oil, sauté garlic and spring onion whites; add vegetables, stir-fry 2 minutes.
Add schezwan sauce and soy sauce.
Add noodles, salt and vinegar; toss on high flame.
Finish with spring onion greens.

name: Chilli Garlic Noodles
preparation: Boil, drain and rinse the noodles.
Heat oil, fry garlic on low until pale gold; add chilli flakes.
Add capsicum, carrot and spring onion whites; stir-fry 1 minute.
Add chilli sauce, soy sauce, vinegar and salt.
Toss in noodles on high heat, finish with spring onion greens.

name: American Chopsuey
ingredients: oil for deep frying the noodles (about 2 cups)
2 cups julienned vegetables (cabbage, carrot, capsicum, beans)
2 tbsp cornflour mixed in ¼ cup water
preparation: Boil noodles until just done, drain, dry on a cloth, then deep-fry in batches until crisp; set aside.
Heat 2 tbsp oil, sauté garlic; add vegetables and mushrooms, stir-fry 3 minutes.
Add ketchup, chilli sauce, soy sauce, vinegar and sugar.
Add stock, boil and thicken with slurry into a glossy sweet-tangy sauce.
Pour hot sauce over crispy noodles just before serving.

name: Burnt Garlic Fried Rice
ingredients: 1 cup finely chopped mixed vegetables (beans, carrot, capsicum)
preparation: Heat oil on medium, fry sliced garlic until deep golden and crisp; remove half for garnish.
Add chilli flakes and vegetables to the remaining garlic oil; stir-fry 2 minutes on high.
Add rice, soy sauce, vinegar, pepper and salt; toss 2 minutes.
Finish with spring onion and the reserved crisp garlic.

name: Singapore-style Rice Noodles
preparation: Soak rice vermicelli in hot water 5 minutes, drain.
Heat oil, fry tofu strips until golden, set aside.
Sauté garlic, add vegetables and stir-fry 2 minutes.
Add curry powder and turmeric, stir 30 seconds; add soy sauce, chilli sauce and salt.
Add noodles, sprouts and tofu; toss on high heat, finish with spring onion.

name: Schezwan Chutney
ingredients: 15 dry red chillies (Kashmiri, soaked in hot water 20 minutes)
preparation: Blend soaked chillies with a little water into a smooth paste.
Heat oil, fry garlic, ginger and celery on low until fragrant, 3 minutes.
Add chilli paste and cook 5 minutes, stirring.
Add ketchup, soy sauce, vinegar, sugar and salt; cook 2 minutes until oil separates.
Cool and store refrigerated up to 2 weeks.

name: Chinese Pickled Vegetables
ingredients: ½ cup rice vinegar (or white vinegar)
preparation: Warm the vinegar with sugar and salt until dissolved; cool.
Pour over the vegetables in a jar and rest 30 minutes (or overnight for deeper flavour).
Serve chilled, sprinkled with sesame seeds and chilli flakes.

name: Date Pancake
preparation: Whisk maida, milk, sugar, butter and baking powder into a smooth thin batter; rest 10 minutes.
Cook dates with 2 tbsp water until soft; mash into a paste.
Make thin pancakes on a lightly oiled pan, spread date paste on one half, fold into quarters.
Pan-fry folded pancakes in a little oil until golden on both sides.
Cut into wedges, sprinkle sesame and drizzle honey.

name: Honey Noodles with Ice Cream
preparation: Boil noodles until just done, drain and dry thoroughly on a cloth.
Deep-fry in batches until golden and crisp; drain.
Melt butter, add honey and warm gently; toss the crisp noodles to coat.
Sprinkle sesame seeds and serve immediately with a scoop of vanilla ice cream.

name: Veg Wonton Soup
ingredients: ½ cup sliced bok choy or spinach
preparation: Mix cabbage, carrot, tofu, ginger, soy sauce, pepper and salt for the filling.
Place a teaspoon of filling in each wrapper, wet the edges and pinch into a wonton.
Bring the stock to a gentle boil, season with salt.
Drop wontons in and simmer 4–5 minutes until they float and the wrapper is translucent.
Add bok choy for the last minute; finish with sesame oil and spring onion greens.

name: Mushroom Clear Soup
preparation: Heat sesame oil, sauté garlic and ginger 30 seconds.
Add mushrooms and cook on high 2 minutes.
Pour in stock, add soy sauce, pepper and salt; simmer 8 minutes.
Serve hot with spring onion greens and coriander.

name: Steamed Veg Momos
ingredients: ¼ cup finely chopped spring onion
preparation: Knead maida, salt and water into a firm dough; rest 20 minutes.
Heat oil, sauté garlic and ginger; add vegetables, soy sauce, pepper and salt; cook 2 minutes and cool.
Roll small thin discs, fill, pleat and seal into momos.
Steam 10–12 minutes until the wrapper turns glossy.
Serve with schezwan chutney.

name: Chilli Baby Corn
preparation: Blanch baby corn 2 minutes, drain and pat dry.
Coat in cornflour, maida, pepper and salt; deep-fry until crisp.
Heat 1 tbsp oil, sauté garlic and green chilli; add onion and capsicum, stir-fry 2 minutes.
Add soy sauce, chilli sauce and vinegar; toss in the baby corn.
Finish with spring onion.

name: Salt and Pepper Vegetables
ingredients: 3 cups mixed vegetables (cauliflower florets, baby corn, capsicum strips, broccoli)
preparation: Toss vegetables in cornflour, rice flour, half the pepper and salt.
Deep-fry in batches until crisp; drain.
Heat 1 tbsp oil, sauté garlic, green chilli and spring onion whites 1 minute.
Add fried vegetables, remaining pepper, chilli flakes, salt and vinegar; toss on high.
Serve immediately with spring onion greens.

name: Chinese Bhel
preparation: Boil noodles until just done, drain, dry on a cloth and deep-fry until crisp; drain.
In a bowl mix schezwan sauce, ketchup, soy sauce and vinegar.
Add cabbage, carrot, capsicum and spring onion; toss.
Add the crispy noodles just before serving so they stay crunchy; season and serve at once.

name: Paneer Manchurian Gravy
ingredients: 2 tbsp cornflour mixed in ¼ cup water (for gravy)
preparation: Coat paneer in cornflour, maida and salt; shallow-fry in 2 tbsp oil until golden.
Heat 1 tbsp oil, sauté garlic, ginger, green chilli and onion 2 minutes.
Add soy sauce, chilli sauce and ketchup; stir 30 seconds.
Add stock, boil, thicken with slurry.
Add paneer and vinegar, simmer 2 minutes, garnish with spring onion.

name: Gobi Manchurian Gravy
ingredients: 2 tbsp cornflour mixed in ¼ cup water (for gravy)
preparation: Blanch florets 2 minutes, drain and pat dry.
Make a thick batter of cornflour, maida, ginger-garlic paste, chilli powder, salt and water; coat florets and deep-fry until crisp.
Heat 1 tbsp oil, sauté garlic, ginger and onion; add soy sauce, chilli sauce and ketchup.
Add stock, boil, thicken with slurry.
Add fried gobi and vinegar just before serving; garnish with spring onion.

name: Vegetable Kung Pao with Cashews
ingredients: 2 cups mixed vegetables (broccoli, capsicum, baby corn, zucchini, cubed)
1 tsp cornflour mixed in 2 tbsp water
preparation: Heat oil, fry dry red chillies 20 seconds; add garlic and ginger.
Add onion and vegetables; stir-fry 3 minutes on high.
Add soy sauce, vinegar, chilli sauce, sugar and stock; thicken with slurry.
Toss in cashews and spring onion, serve with fried rice.

name: Dragon Paneer
preparation: Coat paneer strips in cornflour, maida and salt; deep-fry until crisp.
Heat 1 tbsp oil, sauté garlic and ginger; add onion and capsicum, stir-fry 2 minutes.
Add chilli sauce, soy sauce, ketchup, honey and vinegar; cook 1 minute.
Toss in paneer and cashews to coat.
Finish with spring onion; serve immediately.

name: Tofu and Broccoli in Garlic Sauce
ingredients: 1 tbsp cornflour mixed in ¼ cup water
preparation: Coat tofu in cornflour and pan-fry in 2 tbsp oil until golden on all sides; set aside.
Blanch broccoli 1 minute, drain.
Heat 1 tbsp oil, fry garlic until pale gold; add ginger.
Add soy sauce, chilli sauce, sugar and stock; thicken with slurry.
Add tofu and broccoli, toss, finish with sesame oil and sesame seeds.

name: Vegetables in Schezwan Gravy
ingredients: 3 cups mixed vegetables (cauliflower, carrot, beans, capsicum, baby corn, mushroom)
1½ tbsp cornflour mixed in ¼ cup water
preparation: Blanch the hard vegetables 2 minutes; drain.
Heat oil, sauté garlic, ginger and onion 2 minutes.
Add schezwan sauce, soy sauce and ketchup; stir 30 seconds.
Add vegetables and stock; boil and thicken with slurry.
Finish with vinegar and spring onion.

name: Mushroom Fried Rice
ingredients: ½ cup finely chopped beans and carrot
preparation: Heat oil in a wok, sauté garlic and spring onion whites.
Add mushrooms and cook on high until browned, 3 minutes.
Add beans and carrot, stir-fry 2 minutes.
Add rice, soy sauce, vinegar, pepper and salt; toss 2 minutes.
Finish with spring onion greens.

name: Paneer Fried Rice
ingredients: 1 cup finely chopped mixed vegetables (carrot, beans, capsicum)
preparation: Pan-fry paneer cubes in 1 tbsp oil until golden; set aside.
Heat 2 tbsp oil, sauté garlic and spring onion whites; add vegetables, stir-fry 2 minutes.
Add rice, soy sauce, chilli sauce, vinegar, pepper and salt; toss.
Add paneer, toss gently 1 minute, finish with spring onion greens.

name: Triple Schezwan Fried Rice
ingredients: oil for deep frying half the noodles (about 2 cups)
1 cup finely chopped mixed vegetables (carrot, beans, capsicum, cabbage)
1 tbsp cornflour mixed in ¼ cup water
preparation: Boil noodles; deep-fry half until crisp, keep the rest soft.
Make the rice: heat 1½ tbsp oil, sauté garlic, half the vegetables, 2 tbsp schezwan sauce, rice, salt; toss and set aside.
Make the noodles: heat 1 tbsp oil, sauté the soft noodles with 1 tbsp schezwan sauce and soy sauce.
Make the gravy: heat ½ tbsp oil, sauté remaining vegetables, add 1 tbsp schezwan sauce, stock, vinegar; thicken with slurry.
Plate rice and noodles side by side, pour gravy over, top with crispy noodles and spring onion.

name: Pan-Fried Noodles with Vegetables
ingredients: 2 cups mixed vegetables (bok choy, mushroom, carrot, capsicum, baby corn)
1½ tbsp cornflour mixed in ¼ cup water
preparation: Boil noodles until just done, drain and dry.
Heat 3 tbsp oil in a flat pan, spread the noodles as a cake and fry undisturbed until golden and crisp underneath; flip and crisp the other side.
Heat 1 tbsp oil, sauté garlic and ginger; add vegetables, stir-fry 3 minutes.
Add soy sauce, chilli sauce, sugar and stock; thicken with slurry.
Pour the vegetable gravy over the crispy noodle cake and serve at once.

name: Green Chilli Sauce
preparation: Blend chillies, garlic, sugar, salt and water into a smooth paste.
Simmer with vinegar 5 minutes until slightly thick.
Cool, bottle and refrigerate up to 3 weeks.

name: Sweet Chilli Dipping Sauce
ingredients: 1 tsp cornflour mixed in 2 tbsp water
preparation: Simmer chillies, garlic, sugar, vinegar, water and salt 5 minutes.
Add cornflour slurry and cook until glossy.
Cool before serving with spring rolls or momos.

name: Toffee Banana
ingredients: a bowl of iced water (for setting)
preparation: Whisk maida, cornflour, baking powder and water into a thick batter.
Dip banana chunks and deep-fry until golden; drain.
Heat sugar with 2 tbsp water on medium until it turns amber caramel.
Toss fried bananas in the caramel, sprinkle sesame seeds.
Dip each piece briefly in iced water to set the shell; serve immediately.

name: Jasmine Green Tea with Honey
preparation: Bring water to just under a boil (about 80°C) and pour over the tea leaves.
Steep 3 minutes, strain.
Stir in honey and serve with a lemon slice; also good chilled.
